state.project: Smart Valves At East Villa Rica Switching Station
state.description: Installation of Power Flow Controllers at the new East Villa Rica Switching Station on the Douglasville - Villa Rica 230kV and Summer Lake - Villa Rica 230kV lines. The Power Flow Controllers will be removed when GTCs strategic project at Cavender Drive goes in service.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
